payload.aboutMe: I'm adventurous but practical: I like direct communication, playful confidence, and a plan that leaves room to improvise. I tend to enjoy taking the lead, shared novelty, and a warm reset afterward. Curiosity is an invitation to talk, not automatic consent.

I'm a thoughtful switch who values trust, humor, and unhurried negotiation. Restraint, sensation, and roleplay interest me most when everyone can name what they want and change course easily. I like scenes that feel intentional and aftercare that feels personal.

I'm connection-first and fairly versatile. I enjoy service, affectionate power exchange, body-focused play, and trying a wide range of things at a pace that feels grounded. Clear boundaries, laughter, and checking in the next day all matter to me.

I'm curious, communicative, and still learning what fits. I like affectionate connection, playful power exchange, and trying new things slowly, with clear boundaries and check-ins. I mark fantasies separately from real-world interests so conversations can stay honest and low-pressure.

I'm an experienced switch who enjoys structure, creativity, and partners who communicate plainly. My strongest interests cluster around power exchange, restraint, sensation, and ritual, with plenty of room for tenderness. A high rating means enthusiasm for discussion, never blanket consent.

I'm a submissive. Not a role — the thing I am. I need to be owned, directed, told what to do. The structure of power exchange is where I'm most myself.

I'm drawn to intensity with boundaries. I want to be pushed, used, put in my place — and I want it negotiated, named, and held. The trust matters as much as the act. I give up control, but I don't give up my voice.

I'm an exhibitionist. Being seen turns me on — the vulnerability of it, the being-known. I stream with my partner; being watched isn't a kink I hide.

I'm curious and still discovering. Age play, pet play — I'm exploring what it means to be small, kept, handled. I don't have it all figured out, and I'm honest about that.

What I need from a partner: directness. Tell me what you want. Don't hint, don't dance around it. I respond to clarity and confidence. And after — I need the landing. The check-in, the holding, the confirmation that what we did mattered.

Hard limits: blood, needles, branding, scat, fear play. Anything that causes real harm or doesn't wash off. I want intensity, not injury.
